item.title: Google Engineer Runs 270M-Parameter Model on a Printer
item.description:
Google DeepMind team member Omar Sanseviero demonstrated an extreme experiment: without modifying firmware or adding external compute boards, a printer's built-in PostScript interpreter was used to run inference on a quantized Gemma 3 270M model, peaking at roughly 14.1MB of memory. The setup uses dynamic layer loading, swapping 18 Transformer layers in and out of memory, at a cost of about 60 seconds per generated token. The value lies in probing on-device inference under extreme memory constraints rather than practical performance.

原文标题：谷歌工程师让打印机运行 2.7 亿参数模型

Why it matters：以极端内存约束验证端侧推理边界，对关注量化与低资源部署的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Nvidia in Talks to Acquire Diffusion LLM Startup Inception for Over $500M
item.description:
Nvidia is in advanced talks to acquire AI startup Inception at a valuation of at least $500 million, potentially with performance-based earnouts. Founded in 2024 by Stanford, UCLA and Cornell professors, Inception builds diffusion-based large language models; its Mercury model claims sub-300ms time-to-first-token and 5-7x throughput via parallel generation. If completed, the team could join Nvidia's Nemotron open model efforts and extend diffusion techniques to robotics and physical AI.

原文标题：英伟达拟逾 5 亿美元收购扩散式大模型公司 Inception

Why it matters：英伟达以逾 5 亿美元押注非自回归的扩散式大模型路线，可能重塑推理效率与物理 AI 布局。

item.title: PHP Patches 20-Year-Old Flaw That Silently Disables TLS Encryption
item.description:
The PHP project released security updates including 8.5.13, fixing CVE-2026-128064 (CVSS 8.2), a high-severity flaw in HTTP/FTP stream wrappers. Inconsistent case handling of URL schemes lets HTTPS:// or httpS:// bypass TLS and fall back to plaintext, exposing credentials, cookies and POST data. The bug traces back to PHP 4.3.0, lurking for nearly 20 years.

原文标题：PHP 高危漏洞潜伏近 20 年 大写 S 可绕过 TLS 加密

Why it matters：影响面极广的基础设施级安全漏洞，所有 PHP 后端与运维团队需立即排查升级。

item.title: MetaChip Lights Up Mega188 3D-TPU Chip with 600GB/s DRAM Bandwidth
item.description:
Chinese edge-LLM chip startup MetaChip announced that its 3D-TPU chip Mega188 has successfully taped out and lit up. The chip vertically integrates 2/4/8GB of DRAM via 3D stacking and hybrid bonding, reaching 600GB/s peak memory bandwidth with a 5W low-power mode, and benchmarks at 80 TPS on Qwen3-8B inference.

原文标题：迈特芯 3D-TPU 芯片 Mega188 点亮 带宽 600GB/s

Why it matters：端侧大模型芯片以 3D 堆叠 DRAM 突破内存带宽瓶颈，是国产算力架构路线的重要工程进展。

item.title: Jujutsu Primer Shows Automatic Rebase and Native Undo Reshaping Git Workflows
item.description:
This primer introduces the Jujutsu (jj) version control system to developers already familiar with Git, highlighting primitives like automatic rebase and native undo that smooth Git's sharp edges. Because jj can run side-by-side with Git in the same repository, developers can trial it with low risk and organically discover workflows such as stacked PRs. The author credits jj with keeping VCS bookkeeping out of working memory and teases jj-pancake, a stacked-PR tool.

原文标题：Jujutsu 入门指南 自动变基与原生撤销重塑 Git 工作流

Why it matters：面向 Git 用户的 jj 实操入门，展示了自动变基与堆叠 PR 等可迁移的工程实践。

item.description:
Qualcomm, together with AI private-cloud provider Cirrascale, has opened cloud-based evaluation of its first rack-scale inference solution, Dragonfly AI200, to select customers. Each card carries 768GB of LPDDR5X memory, and a 140kW liquid-cooled rack packs 56 cards with 43TB total memory and 0.414 PB/s bandwidth, targeting 10T-parameter-class inference in a single rack at lower total cost of ownership.

item.title: Agnes Harness Open-Sources Dual-System Agent With 14x Speedup
item.description:
Agnes Harness is an Apache 2.0 open-source agent execution framework with 2.1k GitHub stars, built around a Sys1 dual-system decision mechanism and a TTT×RSI two-layer self-evolution loop. Its authors claim up to 14x higher execution efficiency and 1/27 of the cost, targeting the high per-customer adaptation cost and failure to retain experience that block enterprise agent deployment.

原文标题：Agnes Harness 开源双系统 Agent 提速 14 倍

item.title: Synology DSM Hit by CVSS 9.8 Flaw Allowing Unauthenticated File Access
item.description:
Synology confirmed a CWE-88 argument delimiter flaw in the DSM OAuth Service suite rated CVSS 9.8, letting unauthenticated attackers read or write arbitrary NAS files and trigger denial of service without user interaction. Patched builds for DSM 7.4 and 7.3 are slated for November 20, while 7.2.1, 7.2.2 and 7.1 remain in progress; Synology advises users who cannot upgrade to disable the OAuth Service package.

原文标题：群晖 DSM 曝 CVSS 9.8 漏洞 无需登录可远程读写文件

Why it matters：涉及广泛部署的 NAS 系统最高危漏洞，直接影响企业自托管 AI 与数据基础设施的安全运维。

The project ships source code only, with prebuilt binaries distributed through downstream channels such as Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, BtbN and gyan.dev. For developers running transcoding and streaming pipelines, this is a routine upgrade that warrants a compatibility check.

item.title: GIMP Adds Real-Interface GUI Automated Testing
item.description:
The GIMP project announced a new GUI testing platform that launches the real application, clicks menus and buttons, and verifies results, running automatically on every merged contributor change. Existing unit tests never opened a real window, so they could not catch broken dialogs or menu actions; the new suite closes that gap.

item.title: Bostrom Calculates Delaying Superintelligence Costs Millions of Lives Yearly
item.description:
Nick Bostrom, author of Superintelligence, argues via a simplified model that if superintelligence cures aging, average remaining lifespan for people alive today could stretch from roughly 40 years to about 1,400. As long as AI-caused extinction risk stays below 97%, launching immediately raises expected lifespan, meaning each year of delay costs millions of lives lost to aging.

原文标题：Bostrom 测算：延迟超级智能每年致数百万人死亡

Why it matters：这是 AI 安全与加速主义争论中一个极具争议的量化论证，值得关注 AI 长期风险议题的读者了解其推理框架。

item.description:

This completes the full open-sourcing of the Hunyuan LLM series, with Hy4 and Hy4 preview released under Apache 2.0 for commercial use, plus a system card detailing its defensive-only cybersecurity training approach.

item.title: PostgreSQL 19 Ships REPACK Command and Logical Replication Upgrades
item.description:
PostgreSQL 19 is released with a new REPACK command that reclaims disk space and reorganizes table contents, with a CONCURRENTLY mode that avoids blocking reads and writes. It also adds the pg_plan_advice and pg_stash_advice extensions for planner control, enables logical replication without a server restart, supports sequence-value replication, and adds read-your-writes consistency on standbys.

原文标题：PostgreSQL 19 发布 新增 REPACK 与逻辑复制增强

Why it matters：主流开源数据库年度大版本更新，REPACK 与逻辑复制能力对生产运维有直接价值。

item.title: What Comes After AGI: Researchers Map the Road to Superintelligence
item.description:
Even before AGI is achieved, frontier research has begun systematically examining what comes after it, framing general intelligence as a continuum and mapping possible paths from AGI to artificial general superintelligence (ASI). The work stresses the need for rigorous, reliable ways to track progress, given a shift that could prove far more profound and rapid than AGI itself.

item.title: Postgres 19 Ships Built-In REPACK for Online Table Bloat Cleanup
item.description:
Postgres 19 introduces built-in REPACK CONCURRENTLY, enabling online table rebuilds and bloat reclamation without the long read/write lock imposed by VACUUM FULL or the caveats of third-party extensions. Now at RC1 with GA expected in November or December 2026, it is a meaningful operational win for high-update production databases.

原文标题：Postgres 19 内置 REPACK 在线清理表膨胀

Why it matters：Postgres 核心内置在线表重建能力，直接解决长期困扰生产库的表膨胀运维痛点。

The move accompanies a broader reorganisation that cut nearly 1,100 staff in six months, signalling a structural bet on AI-led R&D and cost reshaping.

item.title: OpenSSL Warns of Critical Buffer Overflow Flaw in EVP_EncodeBlock
item.description:
The OpenSSL project disclosed a buffer overflow in the EVP_EncodeBlock() function tracked as CVE-2026-121481, carrying a maximum-severity CVSS score of 9.8. The flaw sits in libcrypto, the cryptographic library underpinning OpenSSL's TLS, DTLS and QUIC implementations, giving it broad exposure across servers and clients that rely on OpenSSL.

原文标题：OpenSSL 曝 9.8 分缓冲区溢出漏洞

Why it matters：最高危级别的基础设施安全漏洞，直接影响几乎所有依赖 OpenSSL 的 AI 服务与推理集群。

item.title: Micron Says 75% of 2027 Memory Chip Output Already Sold
item.description:
Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said 75% of the company's 2027 memory chip inventory is already sold, with supply-demand tightness expected to exceed 2026 and persist into 2028. Micron has signed 26 strategic customer agreements backed by $32 billion in upfront cash and financial commitments, while betting on 3D DRAM to gain traction in 2028-2029 and scale in 2030-2031.

原文标题：美光 2027 年存储芯片 75% 库存已售罄

Why it matters：存储芯片供需持续收紧直接决定 AI 算力成本与供给节奏，75% 预售比例是判断 2027 年硬件周期的关键信号。
